definitions_note: A definition is a strategy/model rule name; changing market, parameters or rerunning does not create a new definition. Configurations include timeframe, feature-study and execution-session scope. Market cases additionally distinguish the instrument. Historical corrected/interrupted runs are retained. Training screens are approximate and separately labeled; pure model-fit/unit tests and cost-stress reruns are excluded.
counted_attempt_scope: Registered primary evaluations, reference candidate screening/selection grids, dedicated training-attempt records and inner optimization records. Selected micro-validation replays, final-test evaluation, cost-stress reruns and historical auxiliary verification without a dedicated attempt record are reported separately and are not added again to this search-attempt total.
